reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a draggable desktop pet overlay, reflects agent activity through animations, supports custom media and sprite sheets, and tracks local companion interactions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加可拖动的桌面电子宠物，根据 agent 状态显示动画，并支持自定义图片、精灵图和本地互动成长记录。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable desktop pet overlay to DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that reflects agent states with animations and supports custom images, sprite sheets, and local interaction progress.

capabilities: Displays a persistent browser overlay with animated pet states derived from agent activity
Accepts and stores user-uploaded images and sprite sheets locally
Persists pet configuration and interaction statistics through local files or the host settings service
Provides local HTTP endpoints for configuration, media, statistics, and interactions
